slides.heading: GPT-4 and Perplexity
slides.text: GPT-4, at ~0.91, was proficient at utilizing chain-of-thought reasoning productively, which motivated the subsequent targeted elicitation of this capability and the creation of modern reasoning models.

slides.heading: Perplexity and AI Progress
slides.text: Now, as we have reached losses below 0.8, we have seen the emergence of transformative capabilities in fields like cybersecurity and mathematics.
